notes: Scored the fifteen unscored ids carried from run-2026-11-04, oldest first. No newer paper was scored: the cap is 15 cards. Twelve HOLDs, all E-QEC, and three REJECTs. No claim moved and no version bumped. 2611.02411 is Physical Review B 114, L231407 (2026). E-MZM is WATCH, so the journal venue does not bind and does not raise C. 2611.04179 uses reinforcement learning to schedule a qLDPC decoder. That is not Bus A, so E-RL is not bound and there is no bridge. 2611.03128's comment says it was submitted to IEEE Transactions on Quantum Engineering. OAI has no journal-ref, so the venue stays arXiv. 2611.04906 says SPARC is designed to achieve a fusion gain Q>1. That sentence is the machine's design aim in the abstract. It is not this paper's output and it is not Q_eng. No AUTO-MERGED PATCH. Harvest raw hits 439, unique arXiv ids 342, of which 0 were already in the catalog. Repeated hits across queries are 97. Category windows were truncated, so the unscored list is the next program slice, not every hit. The scored carry-overs were submitted 2026-10-29 through 2026-11-03, which is before this lookback window; they were resolved again by id list.
